digest.component_or_area: ticket summary resolution and agent guidance
propositions: summary_compute resolves ticket state but omits the resolved alias field from return payload, causing agents to copy collision-prone four-character prefixes instead of durable aliases
the summary schema, library, MCP, and CLI contracts institutionalize an alias-free shape, making short prefixes locally salient and agents' default selection

agents produce 25/25 four-character prefix commands when local summaries lack aliases, but produce 25/25 alias commands when the alias field is present and affirmative guidance directs alias use for tracker commands
the fail-closed ambiguous-prefix resolver and canonical UUID controls remain correct; the defect is incomplete implementation of WS5 agent-fitness intent requiring id+alias in summary contracts
